name: Antepia Restaurant und Hotel
beschreibung: The Antepia Restaurant and Hotel is located in **Kufstein**, Tyrol. The accommodation is situated in the city center, close to the historic old town. It combines overnight stays with a gastronomic operation. The restaurant specializes in oriental and Mediterranean cuisine. The guest rooms are modernly furnished and include a bathroom and satellite television. Visitors can stay overnight and dine on-site. The central location makes it easy to explore **Kufstein** and the surrounding Tyrolean region.
